meta.name: de-ai-writer
meta.description: AI 文案去味器。用户提供 AI 生成的文本（公众号/小红书/电商文案等），觉得“太 AI 味”要改得更自然、更像人写的时使用。输出自然有人味的中文。De-AI writer: rewrite AI-generated copy (WeChat articles, Xiaohongshu, e-commerce) into natural, human-sounding Chinese text.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 改写机器味文案为自然口语
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常用AI写宣传文案,却嫌太生硬想改成自然口吻。
copy.tagline_en: Rewrite AI-generated copy into natural, human-sounding Chinese.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI to write marketing copy but find it too robotic and want it to sound natural.

howto.what: 将你提供的 AI 文案改写成自然、有真人味的中文，去除空洞拔高、排比三连、官方黑话和模板化结尾。
howto.when: 当你说出“去AI味”“改得像人写的”等要求，或请它润色公众号/小红书等文案时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这段话去去AI味，改得像人写的。
say.note: 它会重写你粘贴的文本。

say.text: 这段小红书文案太官方了，改自然点。
say.note: 它会按自然口语风格改写。

howto.what_en: Rewrites AI-generated Chinese copy into natural, human-sounding text, removing empty hype, parallel triads, official jargon, and templated endings.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to 'remove AI flavor' or 'make it sound human,' or when asking to polish WeChat/Xiaohongshu/e-commerce copy.

say_en.text: Help me remove the AI flavor from this and make it sound human.
This Xiaohongshu copy is too official; make it more natural.
say_en.note: It rewrites in a casual spoken style.
